# CampingRoute

> CampingRoute is an AI-powered European campsite search, road trip planner, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing verified campground data, hiking trails, and events.

## Core Services

- [Campsite & Stellplatz Search](https://campingroute.app/discover): Natural language search across 20,000+ European campgrounds, RV parks, and attractions.
- [AI Prompt Generator](https://campingroute.app/prompt-generator): Tailor-made camper itinerary prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini with GPX export.
- [Official MCP Server](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Model Context Protocol server exposing 10 structured tools for AI assistants.

## MCP Tools

- [search_places](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Search campgrounds and RV parks with filters for country, type, and amenities.
- [get_place_details](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Retrieve verified coordinates, contact details, pricing, and sanitary amenities.
- [get_german_trails](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Search official hiking and cycling trails via DZT Knowledge Graph.
- [get_german_events](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Search upcoming festivals, wine fairs, and cultural events across Germany.
- [get_german_pois](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Search verified points of interest, castles, and national parks.
- [get_reviews](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Retrieve community reviews and ratings for campgrounds.
- [add_review](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Submit ratings and feedback for visited campsites.
- [get_lists](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Retrieve user-curated road trip lists.
- [create_list](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Create a new road trip list.
- [save_to_list](https://campingroute.app/discover/mcp): Save a campground to a road trip list.

## Optional

- [Full MCP Schema Documentation](https://campingroute.app/llms-full.txt): Complete tool signatures, JSON Schema parameters, and sample client configurations.
- [Open Data Attributions](https://campingroute.app/impressum): Attributions for OpenStreetMap (ODbL), Wikidata (CC0), and German National Tourist Board (DZT).
